analysis:
Only docs/developer/build.md changed (base lines 951-1215 and head lines 1-448 were supplied). The change is documentation only, with no code, configuration, or workflow changes. I found no new attack surface and no new security regression.

Security-relevant statements in the head text:
- Head line 257 says release publication stages an immutable digest path. It then registers the exact official build through the existing scoped POST /v1/releases, with no per-release hardware qualification or manual approval. This matches the canonical context on durable official-build registration (A-017, A-005, T-054). It also states that runtime Apple proof and receipt verification remain mandatory.
- Head lines 259-263 say secret-bearing release jobs accept only verified signed annotated production tags in reviewed master ancestry, or trusted master for dev/manual/recovery runs. They use repository-scoped secrets with no environment approval attachments, and assume trusted repository writers. The release supply chain is out of scope in the threat model, so this is not a regression. A later pass may check whether the described assumption holds in the actual .github workflows, which were not supplied.
- Head lines 334-337 say protected signing and publication jobs retain their existing approvals and credential scopes. This conflicts slightly with head lines 259-263, which say there are no environment approval attachments. It is only a doc inconsistency, not evidence of a control change.
- Head lines 277-283 describe Bedrock/OpenRouter review tooling. This is advisory CI and not a runtime asset.

The base text window starts at line 951 and the head window is lines 1-448, so I could not align the two for a full diff. The head text is truncated at line 448. Coverage of the CI workflows, scripts, and release-publication code that these docs describe is a limit for the next pass, since none of it was in this batch.
